text: Companion to L1(a) bd-01M15F41VCJ6SVW5J0252DEJXN (static-edition laws, cursor-grok-visual-qa). L1(a) asserts over the STATIC edition output; L1(b) asserts the same contracts over the LIVE Laminar app at storyatlas4s abf4608 - the shell landed with a DOM text rail (one span per fragment), per-page Intaglio SVG overlays, an epistemic playhead (ReaderAt snapped to code points, explicit Omniscient), and selection via SceneNavigation/NavigationIndex. What it must assert, and the rule is the same as L1(a): STRUCTURAL ASSERTIONS ONLY, no pixel gates - screenshots are for human review, never for pass/fail. (1) V-T2: the concatenation of the rail's fragment spans hashes to the source checksum, live in the browser, after the app has rendered - the shell already verifies this by hash at startup, so the test is that it stays true under navigation and playhead movement. (2) V-I2: every overlay mark resolves to a mark id present in the compiled view; no orphan SVG nodes. (3) V-L2: a selection renders as OnMark, ViaAncestor or OffProjection and never as anything else, and - once the parity fix lands - the placement the app shows equals the one the compiler computed. That last assertion should be added only AFTER the parity bead closes, since today the two surfaces genuinely disagree (horizon leak, post-01M15R24RG6P2XC2A1XYJ4FB65). (4) Moving the playhead never reveals a mark whose evidence is outside the horizon at that ReaderAt. Owner: cursor-grok-visual-qa after L1(a). Use the project's installed Playwright browser, never the system Chrome, and close pages/contexts/browsers when the suite finishes.
